notes.title: v1.03 - Controller Support, Brightness Settings and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Controller Support (Xbox)
Xbox controller support and interface icons have been added. (There might be issues in some cases; please report any problems via email.)

Brightness, Contrast, and Saturation Settings
You can make visual adjustments by pressing the "Brightness Settings" button in the options menu. (Due to an issue, these settings revert to default when you restart the game; will fix this in a future update.)

 Minor bugs and interface errors have been fixed.


For assistance or to report bugs, please email: blodfestgames@gmail.com

notes.title: v1.0.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Fixed an interface bug that occurred after talking to the Master Blacksmith.
 Fixed an issue preventing quest rewards from being given if the Stranger's dialogue was skipped after completion.
 Increased the damage dealt by Forgotten Hunter, Narkul, Baelgor, and Zephros slightly.
 Fixed a bug that prevented the Hellsword and Demonsword from working in certain situations.
 Various translation adjustments.
 Visual improvements.
 Fixed several issues in the dialogue with the Witch.
 Fixed a bug preventing the reset of Hellfire and Judgement during skill tree reset.


Known Bugs:

 It appears that Master Blacksmith is experiencing a slight memory lapse - constantly. Every time you teleport to the Sanctuary, the dialogues reset to the beginning. We will fix this issue as soon as possible.


For assistance or to report bugs, please email: blodfestgames@gmail.com

notes.title: Full Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

With great excitement and joy, I am thrilled to announce the release of my first game, Blood Within. This journey has been an incredible adventure, and I couldn't be more grateful for the unwavering support and encouragement along the way.

I want to extend my heartfelt thanks to anyone who believed in this project and contributed to its realization. Your feedback, passion, and dedication have been instrumental in shaping Blood Within into the game it is today.

If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to reach out to me via email at blodfestgames@gmail.com. Your feedback is invaluable as we continue to improve and evolve the game.

Thank you once again for your incredible support. I hope you enjoy playing Blood Within as much as I enjoyed creating it.

Happy hunting! 

Mirac "Volviir" Genc
Developer/Designer, Blodfest Games
